hook_text: I'm the Map Master. Give me a topographic map and two spot heights, and I'll tell you if you can cycle it.
clip_script: I am Dr Molefe. I am the Map Master. Give me a topographic map and two spot heights, and I'll tell you if you can cycle it. But today, we're looking at rivers. Imagine a river near the end of its course, meandering sluggishly on a broad flood plain. Now, imagine a tectonic uplift event. The entire landmass rises. The river's base level drops. It responds immediately. Its energy spikes, and it begins rapid downward erosion. It doesn't widen the valley; it cuts straight down, creating a steep, V-shaped gorge. The flat areas left high above the new channel are river terraces. They are the undeniable signature of a river waking up. Numbers and diagrams never lie. Study well.
visual_style: Documentary-style formal presentation, cutting to a sharp whiteboard animation drawing the initial flat flood plain, then violently dropping the base level and cutting a deep V-shaped red channel into the white lines, labelling the terraces.
pacing: Steady, purposeful, dropping beats on the terminology
